notes.title: Dev Update 1
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Updates[/h1]
[h2]Lilac - Visual Update[/h2]

Our crystallized mole just got a glow-up! Lilac has a brand-new look and is ready to shine on the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/f18695007134338d7667543841cd0b98e7ece608.gif[/img]

[h2]Sid- Skill Rework[/h2]

Sid has undergone intense training and has enhanced his fire-spitting ability! Soon, you’ll get to experience the most powerful flamethrower around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/704c256b46d1603f20f9be8de2e22d02d6a150a3.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Traits[/b][/h1]

Choosing your squad just got even more strategic with the arrival of [b]Traits[/b]! Now, you can benefit from relationships, characteristics, and even elemental affinities shared among your squad members! Each character has three unique traits! Ready for some [b]spoilers[/b]?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/1cd4f2a0fe5f61d051b4aa763ba60f7f9f15da52.png[/img]

🔹 [b]Bouncy: Dex + Hop Hop [/b]
The power of jumping when you need it the most! Whenever you take damage, your main character will leap to gain an advantage!

🔹 [b]Sisters: Kiara + Blip[/b]
Sisterhood is precious! With our feline duo united, they can occasionally use each other's abilities!

🔹 [b]Crystal: Lilac + Edge + Blip + ???[/b]
Harness the power of the crystal element in your team and summon swirling crystal dust whenever you defeat corrupted enemies, dealing damage and slowing them down!


[h2]New Lands![/h2]

After exploring the Kashmyr Archipelago and the Nimbus Forest, you will now venture into the Shadowweave Village and then the One-Eyed Road! The challenges in these two new maps are insane (and fun)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/d4d9d91bed971dfcaf82a4ae8397acc2219d0724.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/3a6fe16cf5196d0c3fd2574f5573802ebeb16bfd.gif[/img]

[h2]Relics[/h2]

Sid’s grandfather, the legendary [b]Sidolfus[/b], has a knack for uncovering rare and powerful relics! After overcoming certain challenges, he’ll be able to retrieve these mystical artifacts, each carrying a unique effect to aid you in battle.

Our goal is to bring you around [b]100 different relics[/b], allowing endless possibilities for creative and strategic builds! And, of course, we won’t leave you in the dark—we've got some exciting [b]spoilers [/b]coming your way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/e53b2cdedbab8e4498bc57babaf311d4134d617f.png[/img]

🟢 [b]Soap Amulet[/b] – Healing bubbles will appear when you take damage!
🔥 [b]Charred Bone[/b] – Summons a blazing canine ally to fight by your side! [strike](Maybe you've seen him around 👀)[/strike]
💥 [b]Glass Cannon[/b] – Increases the damage you deal, but also the damage you take!


That's all for today! Enjoyed the spoilers? Stay tuned for more exciting updates coming soon, [strike]especially for those who love playing with a friend![/strike]

notes.title: Shard Squad Demo Update v0.4
notes.content:
⚡ New Squad Member: [b]Nana[/b], the [i]Electric Star[/i]! ⚡
"Welcome the most [i]electrifying [/i]member of the squad! 💫 Nana is ready to shock a legion of fans [i](including her beloved Sid!)[/i] with her energetic groove! Get ready to dance with our [b]Electric Star[/b]! 🎶⚡"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/14173acc94e989ce6d8983f26b47366b4ecf4936.gif[/img]

🌲 New Level Unlocked! 🌧️
Welcome to [b]Nimbus Forest[/b]! 🌿 Once a peaceful forest, this rainy land is now cursed by the wailing of the calamity [b]Zarudam[/b]! 🌩️ Lightning and thunder await the bravest squad members! ⚔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/3d2b27b824c68b7ee02d26b123175f5c41ffd089.png[/img]

⚖️ Game Balance Update!
We've made some difficulty adjustments! Let us know what you think! 📢🎮

🎮 Controller Support!
You can now play Shard Squad with your favorite controller! 🕹️🔥 Give it a try!

🖥️ New In-Game Interface!
We've updated the game's visuals! ✨ Feel free to share your thoughts! 💬
